model.name: Mobile-first responsive 3-way merge with ONE continuous spline ribbon (both orientations)
model.description: The 3-way merge is mobile-first responsive and draws ONE continuous spline ribbon per change across all 3 editors (Rider 'Merge Revisions' fidelity), in BOTH orientations. Tron REJECTED the R30.32 box-outlines (v0.7.46): isolated per-pane rectangles show PRESENCE not MAPPING. Instead: for each change region compute its top/bottom Y in Local/Result/Repository and emit ONE SVG path that enters at Local's range, cubic-bezier across the left gutter into Result's range, bezier across the right gutter into Repository's range - a SINGLE filled ribbon whose curves absorb the per-pane Y offset so any change is traceable Local->Result-> Repository at a glance. Responsive: on mobile (<=~820px) the 3 panes STACK and the spline flows DOWN across them; on desktop the panes are side-by-side and the spline flows ACROSS. Splines not boxes - subtle translucent shading color-coded by kind (change/ conflict/active), readable on the ~#111 gutter, NO hard outlines. Mobile-first (390px) + desktop-reliable. SUPERSEDES R30.32 (delete the box-outline renderers). Client-facing -> version-bump + atomic (R30.28).
model.tronQuote: > TRON: use SPLINES instead of boxes. clear CONTINUOUS mapping. ONE spline ACROSS 3 editors. [+ mobile <=~820px = 3 stacked panes, spline flows DOWN; desktop side-by-side, spline ACROSS; Rider-fidelity; gate by 390px-mobile+desktop screenshot+pixel, never DOM-count.]

acceptanceCriteria.text: ONE continuous filled spline ribbon per change flows Local -> Result -> Repository as a SINGLE SVG path (cubic-bezier across each gutter, absorbing the per-pane Y offset) - NOT per-pane boxes/bands. The box-outline + trapezoid-band renderers are REPLACED/deleted (supersedes R30.32).

Responsive BOTH orientations: mobile (viewport <=~820px) = 3 STACKED panes with the spline flowing DOWN across them; desktop = side-by-side panes with the spline flowing ACROSS. Both render the continuous ribbon correctly.
Splines not boxes: subtle translucent shading color-coded by kind (change=blue / conflict=red-pink / active=green), opaque enough to read on the ~#111 gutter, NO hard outlines.

At a glance ANY change is traceable from the Local pane through the merged Result to the Repository pane - the continuous mapping IS the requirement (Rider 'Merge Revisions' fidelity target). Inline accept controls (x reject / >> accept-toward-result / <<) sit ON the ribbon edge without occluding it.
Mobile-FIRST (works at 390px) and desktop-reliable; the layout + spline are correct on a 390px phone and on desktop.

GATE = 390px-mobile screenshot + desktop screenshot + PIXEL comparison vs the Rider target image - NEVER DOM/element-count (a 3rd false-green is unacceptable). Client-facing -> version-bump + atomic deploy (R30.28).
